revision_2: dataset moved to v05, the first build that applies the pre-registered covariate quality rules; v04 is kept but its water temperature channel contains values that cannot be measurements (up to 1310 deg C), which influenced early-stopping selection

masks now declare visible_roles explicitly; e2a_strict is restored as the strict no-future-context temporal control and the previous partial-selection variant is renamed e2b_partial_hiddenctx and marked diagnostic
the H2X trunk is constructed through the released interface only, so the committed repository runs without unreleased gate selectors
clip reporting is generated from the per-run predictions instead of a fixed statement
revision_3: dataset moved to v06; the v05 bytes were destroyed by a worktree/junction incident and cannot be restored, so the r2 runs remain as saved results whose input snapshot is unavailable
cache completeness is now audited against the NWIS series catalog; 48 stations were short and the fetch path no longer caches a truncated response
the frozen masks declare the grid they were encoded on and are migrated by station/month when the grid changes
dataset versions are published once: a registered version is never re-bound and an unregistered file is not overwritten by default
NWIS discharge goes through the same quality rules as the WQP covariates, with a two-sided magnitude bound
the T18 no-message control has its own 40-run grid, gate and decision, and a network claim exports it

description: H3-A: independent environmental base prediction + static river-network residual branch. log1p(DOC) space: z_hat = base + correction.

dataset.note: v06 development data: the covariate quality rules applied on top of a rebuilt cache, with cache completeness checked against the NWIS catalog. The providers keep publishing, so this grid has 653 months and 32420 observed cells; masks are migrated to it by station/month. Mixed station types and era mismatch limits still apply.
dataset.v05_status: the v05 bytes were destroyed locally and cannot be restored; the revision-2 runs remain as saved results whose input snapshot is unavailable
dataset.why_replaced: the v04 water temperature channel carried provider values that cannot be measurements (up to 1310 deg C at 05357225, June 2017); they reached the model inputs and influenced early-stopping selection in the T01-T16 round

masks.visibility_rule: every mask stores a visible_roles array; only the roles it lists may be opened in the selection/validation forward, and val/test may never be listed

role_rules.train: gradient targets and visible context; half re-masked visible each epoch
role_rules.val: internal validation targets: never in training input, never in the loss; scored and used for early stopping
role_rules.val_context: opened only when the mask lists it in visible_roles (currently e2b_partial); otherwise recorded but closed, never fitted, never scored
role_rules.context: legacy E2b future context: always visible, never fitted, never scored
role_rules.test: outer test cells/stations: always hidden in every pilot stage; only the frozen evaluation entry may open them

h3a_no_message.note: T18 control: identical to h3a but the correction branch is fed an empty edge set, so relation paths stay inactive while the self path remains. Defined here so it needs no later re-freeze; trained only if the T17 structural gain holds.

init.scheme: pytorch Linear default (kaiming_uniform a=sqrt(5) weight, U(-1/sqrt(fan_in), 1/sqrt(fan_in)) bias), drawn from an explicit torch.Generator so construction order cannot change the parameters
init.env_vs_h3a_base: identical sub-seed and identical module structure, so the two base branches start bit-identical
init.zero_head_note: with a zero correction head the correction backbone receives no gradient on the first backward pass; this is expected and is asserted in T07. The base branch and the head itself still receive gradients from step one.
init.decomposition_note: the base/correction split is a numeric decomposition, not an identifiable ecological process decomposition

training.loss_scope: train cells of the current month only
training.update_unit: one month = one full-graph forward/backward; month order reshuffled every epoch
training.remask_rule: every epoch a fresh random half of the train cells is visible as context and the other half is hidden and carries the loss
training.deterministic_seeding: torch.manual_seed(seed); numpy.random.seed(seed); numpy default_rng(seed) for the cell permutation

prediction.clip_rule: clamp the log1p prediction to [min(train log labels), quantile(train log labels, 0.995)]
prediction.mgL_transform: expm1 applied once to the whole log1p prediction; base and correction are never expm1-ed separately before summing
prediction.export_scope_pilot: internal validation cells only; no outer-test metric is computed or stored in pilot/expand stages

seeds.note: training seeds test optimisation stability only; they are not independent ecological replicates

metrics.space: mg/L for the headline metrics, computed on internal validation (val) cells only
metrics.raw_definition: sqrt(mean((log1p(y_true) - total_log)^2)) on unclipped log1p output; this is the early-stopping criterion, reported alongside the frozen clipped metric
metrics.aggregation: within a scenario average the masks first, then average over training seeds; never pool cells across masks

promotion.scope: development decision at T16; these thresholds are decision rules, not ecological effect sizes or significance tests
promotion.artifact_and_isolation_checks: all runs audited, all hidden-label isolation tests green
promotion.on_failure: diagnose on the existing validation results only; do not extend training, do not add seeds to pick the best result. The next structural change starts a new protocol and a new directory.

expand.scope: T17 five-seed decision over the 8 key scenarios; E1/E3 average their masks first and then their seeds, E2a and E2b are reported separately

budget.note: staged plan: this round executes smoke + first_real + pilot_fill = 27 formal configurations.
